text:
andrew: Kicking off 'crescendo' rollout for v2.3.1. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Slice windows 15m hold, then ramp 25%/60%/100% with 15m pads. tagging @sre-oncall @nina

deploy-bot: Rollout command accepted: release=v2.3.1 commit=sha-def456 profile=crescendo slice=us canary=3 probes=health,smoke

nina: Quick capacity read: US GPU pool ~65% used (burst headroom ~22%), EU ~50% (warm 60%), APAC ~30%. US has 90 free inference slots reported.

rex: Note: model variant uses 6144 ctx; last month we saw cold-start mem spike ~2.1GB on first few requests. Recommend prewarm.

sre-oncall: Proposed SLO triggers: p99 > 550ms for 4m OR error rate >0.8% for 3m OR node GPU util >92% for 4m -> escalate. Keep auto-rollback armed.

zoe: Suggest EU fallback pinned to v2.3.1-ramtrim to avoid mem spike; `ramtrim` drops activation retention but has same logits. Need thumbs from ML.

vikas: Rollback rules draft:
- immediate rollback on sustained error rate >1% for 3m
- staged rollback (scale back to 25%) if p99 > 2x baseline for 10m
- immediate abort if GPU util >95% on >2 nodes for 2m
Agree?

andrew: Fine. Add automated fallback to v2.2.10 if canary 500s >0.4% in first 12m. Also auto-pin EU->ramtrim if EU mem breach >80%.

deploy-bot: Canary logs:
```
[00:01] canary-a ok
[00:03] warn: retry=1 route=us latency=135ms
[00:05] canary-b ok
[00:07] warn: probe-latency avg=230ms
[00:09] info: smoke-test pass=98/100
```

nina: Ran smoke 120rps for 3m -> 0.18% 500s, p95 +15ms. Good to move to 25% after warmup.

rex: Prewarm command: `rictl warm --model v2.3.1 --prefix popular-prompts --region us --concurrency 4` (est time ~4m). Doing it now.

sre-oncall: Also flag: EU has planned network window at 01:00-01:20 UTC. If that stays, we'll hold EU step until it's clear. Recommend swapping APAC/EU order if necessary.

andrew: Swap plan accepted if maintenance holds. For now US -> EU as planned; holdpoints at T+15m. Starting traffic to US at 12%.

deploy-bot: Traffic update: us=12% eu=0% apac=0% state=running next_holdpoint=T+15m

vikas: Adding note for release notes: mention ramtrim fallback, prewarm step, and canary thresholds. Also doc the cresendo pacing so customers know CAUTION.

zoe: ML thumbs: ramtrim acceptable for most conversational evals, minor variance in verbose tokens. We'll run regression-chat set at T+10.

andrew: If we pass holdpoint, plan to go 25% -> 60% -> 100% at +15m increments. On any trigger rollback to v2.2.10 and postmortem.

rex: Prewarm finished, logs -> https://cw.example/prewarm/3687654321 (cold-starts reduced).

sre-oncall: Monitoring dashboards: https://dash.example/s/v2-3-1-us (p95 stable, p99 +20ms). No GPU alarms.

nina: Proceeding to 25%.

deploy-bot: Traffic update: us=25% eu=0% apac=0% state=running next_holdpoint=T+30m

vikas: Reminder: ensure deploy notes call out quant-variance and fallback behavior. Ops runbook updated with explicit `deploy-bot rollback` steps.

andrew: Thanks team. Keep this thread for live notes. Ping on any anomalies or if we need to change region order. :white_check_mark:
